However, for the purpose of preparation of the Consolidated Financial Statements for the FY 2025-26, the financial results of Hindustan Urvarak & Rasayan Limited have been considered based on its Audited Financial Statements for the year ended 31st March 2026. In case of Talcher Fertilizers Limited, CIL NTPC Urja Private Limited and Coal Lignite Urja Vikas Private Limited, management-certified unaudited financial statements for the year ended 31st March 2026 have been considered. Further, the Consolidated Financial Statements include the financial results of International Coal Ventures Private Limited for the period from 1st April 2022 to 31st March 2025 and for the subsequent period i.e. from 1st April 2025 to 31st March 2026 not being available have not been incorporated therein.
